mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO iot_telemetry_sample ( observed_at, message_id, sample_index, device_id, binding_generation, property_code, value_json, received_at) VALUES
(#{sample.observedAt}, #{sample.messageId}, #{sample.sampleIndex}, #{sample.deviceId}, #{sample.bindingGeneration}, #{sample.propertyCode}, CAST(#{sample.valueJson} AS JSONB), #{sample.receivedAt})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO iot_event ( occurred_at, message_id, device_id, binding_generation, event_code, source_event_id, data_json, device_occurred_at, received_at) VALUES (#{event.occurredAt}, #{messageId}, #{event.deviceId}, #{event.bindingGeneration}, #{event.eventCode}, #{event.sourceEventId}, CAST(#{dataJson} AS JSONB), #{event.deviceOccurredAt}, #{event.receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
